shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: They make breakfast. / They use the computer. / They come to my house. / He is writing now.
assets.prompt: A BRIGHT OPEN-PLAN FAMILY HOME seen from one side, with four separate scenes from left to right: (1) two adults MAKING BREAKFAST together at the kitchen counter, frying eggs and making toast; (2) two children USING A COMPUTER together at a desk, both looking at the screen; (3) two guests with a bag COMING IN through the open front door; (4) a man sitting at a small table WRITING in a notebook with a pen. Each scene has clear space around it. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

assets.item: It is January. / It is April. / My birthday is in July. / It is December.

reference_file.observed_description: A whiteboard year planner in a wooden frame on a beige wall: the year 2023 at the top and twelve boxes in three rows of four, numbered 1 to 12, each with two small grids of squares.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows a framed whiteboard year planner with twelve numbered boxes (1 to 12) under a year. Keep the board, frame, wall, numbers, box lines and the small grids in every box exactly as they are, with the same framing. Add ONE change: in box 7 only, draw a small pink birthday cake with three candles in the upper right of the box, as a simple marker drawing. No loop, no circle, no other drawing, no new writing.
